source: Central Ground Water Board (CGWB) — Dynamic Ground Water Resources of India, 2023 assessment, tehsil-wise for NCT of Delhi
source_note: Categories below are the tehsil-wise 2023 assessment as reported in Indian press coverage of the CGWB compilation (Times of India, 3 December 2023). CGWB assesses groundwater by administrative assessment unit; for Delhi the unit is the tehsil.
newer_assessment_note: A 2025 national compilation reports Delhi's 34 assessment units as 10 over-exploited, 11 critical, 6 semi-critical and 7 safe, but its per-tehsil breakdown is not published in a form this project could read. The 2023 per-tehsil categories are used here and labelled with their year rather than presented as current.
resolution_note: A category describes a whole tehsil — typically tens of square kilometres. The demo zones are 600 m cells. A zone therefore inherits its tehsil's category; it is not a measurement taken at the zone.

categories.safe: Groundwater extraction is below the annually replenishable resource.
categories.semi_critical: Extraction is approaching the replenishable limit.
categories.critical: Extraction is at or near the replenishable limit, with declining water levels.
categories.over_exploited: Annual extraction exceeds the annually replenishable resource.

tehsil_coverage_note: 23 of Delhi's ~33 tehsils appear in the sourced table. Zones whose tehsil is absent report no category rather than borrowing a neighbour's.

lodhi-garden.note: New Delhi district is certain; the zone sits near the Chanakyapuri / Connaught Place / Parliament Street tehsil boundaries and the exact containing tehsil was not verified against a boundary dataset.

nehru-park.note: The zone is within Chanakyapuri by name and location.

sanjay-van.note: Vasant Kunj falls within the Vasant Vihar tehsil.

anand-vihar.note: East district; the zone lies near the Preet Vihar / Vivek Vihar boundary. Preet Vihar has no category in the sourced table, so none is reported.

connaught-place.note: Connaught Place has no category in the sourced table, so none is reported.

karol-bagh.note: The zone is within the Karol Bagh tehsil by name and location.

punjabi-bagh.note: Punjabi Bagh has no category in the sourced table, so none is reported.

rk-puram.note: South West district; R K Puram is administratively within the Delhi Cantonment tehsil, but the adjacent Vasant Vihar tehsil is also plausible at this boundary. Both are categorised over-exploited, so the reported category does not depend on which is correct.

okhla-industrial.note: South East district; the zone sits near the Kalkaji / Sarita Vihar boundary. Both are categorised critical, so the reported category does not depend on which is correct.

mayapuri.note: West district; Mayapuri lies near the Rajouri Garden / Patel Nagar boundary, which are categorised over-exploited and critical respectively, so the boundary does affect the reported category here.
